snapshot: 2026-09-18 latest accessible Harbor Hub dataset tags

selection.dataset_scope: every dataset with at least one static-compatible task version
selection.dynamic_task_scope: every task version that passed dynamic verification in the local run
selection.static_only_task_scope: one deterministic static-compatible representative for each dataset without dynamic verification
selection.dynamic_rule: environment built or materialized and reward output verified; dynamic tasks also passed static screening
selection.deterministic_rule: representatives are the first task identity in ascending (task, digest) order

important: Dynamic verification does not imply model-training readiness or benchmark-performance quality. Fetch and rerun harborrl hub inspect and doctor for the selected revision.
